# Sketch

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 2 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Design-tool marketing: serif display on a pale wash, black pill CTA, plan cards with a yearly/monthly pill, and a separate dark account shell.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the signed-out sign-in and signup pages; signup was not submitted). Themes: light, dark.

Sketch's public marketing site and the signed-out account shell, captured on 19 November 2026. Marketing pages are light. The sign-in and signup pages are a separate dark UI. Widths are 1440 and 390 CSS pixels. Nothing was signed in, and no payment or license key was entered.

## Typography

11 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Georgia, Inter.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Reckless Medium and SemiBold are self-hosted at `/webfonts/reckless/` and are proprietary. Marfa is the older body face and is also proprietary. Inter Variable is loaded from `rsms.me` on the marketing site. The account shell loads Inter from Google Fonts. Tokens name Inter and a serif fallback. The font files are not committed.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The marketing body computed line-height is 16px. The body token uses the declared paragraph line-height of 24px, and the source says so. The primary button's computed radius is 24px. The stylesheet says 1rem. The token uses the computed value. Account dark is the sign-in shell, not a dark theme of the marketing site. The marketing page stayed light while the OS colour scheme was dark. Reckless and Inter Variable are not in the package. The style guide uses Georgia and Inter. The pricing ribbon element's computed colour was `#212123` on a `#212123` background. The screenshot shows light text, so that computed colour is not used as the ribbon's text token.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the black pill for the primary action.** The home and nav CTAs are `#151515` with white type and a 24px radius. [components/crops/button-primary-default.png](components/crops/button-primary-default.png)
- **Set display type in the serif, body type in Inter.** Hero and plan names are Reckless at weight 500. UI text is Inter. [screenshots/home-light-default.png](screenshots/home-light-default.png)
- **Keep the marketing site light.** A dark colour scheme did not flip the public pages. Dark values belong to the account shell. [screenshots/pricing-light-default.png](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png)
- **Leave payment and license forms out.** Those flows were not opened. [patterns.md](patterns.md)
